items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: And, uh, I came across a copy of Always, that incidentally is autographed. By Irving Berlin.

ctx.x: You can, you can find a lot of those things.

You can, but let me tell you how much you'll pay for it. Mm-hmm. Through the nose. In, uh, outside of Decatur, Illinois, last year my wife and I went up, went out to this place way out in the country that sells antiques and junk with a Q, you know. Mm-hmm. And, uh, I came across a copy of Always, that incidentally is autographed. By Irving Berlin. Gee. And, uh, the guy opened up his heart and soul to me for four dollars. That seems cheap, but it's not a good thing. Yeah, I, I'm not sure he was aware that it was…
The score on rate was $2, $3, $4, depending on the condition of it.
